notEmpty.message: This box is empty. Write the title. Without it the page shows a blank heading.

noTrailingColon.message: This heading ends with a colon (“{text}”). Remove the colon.

notEmpty.message: This box is empty. Write the headline. Without it the page shows a blank heading.

noTrailingColon.message: This heading ends with a colon (“{text}”). Remove the colon.

noLinks.message: The subheadline has a link in it. The banner shows plain text only, so the link is removed. Take the link out here and put it in the Intro instead.

maxWords.message: The subheadline is {n} words. Keep it to one sentence of 35 words or fewer, and move the rest into the Intro.

maxParagraphs.message: The subheadline is {n} paragraphs. Keep it to one sentence, and move the rest into the Intro.

notEmpty.message: This box is empty. Write the overview heading. Without it the page shows a blank heading.

noTrailingColon.message: This heading ends with a colon (“{text}”). Remove the colon.

minWords.message: The intro is {n} words. Aim for 50 to 110 words: one paragraph that sets up the whole article. Add a sentence or two.

maxWords.message: The intro is {n} words. Aim for 50 to 110 words: one paragraph that sets up the whole article. Move the extra detail into a section.

containsAny.message: The help paragraph should name Acme Home, or say “Our local ... professionals”. Add a sentence about what the professionals do for this topic.

minWords.message: The help paragraph is {n} words. Write 25 to 75 words, in 2 to 4 sentences.

maxWords.message: The help paragraph is {n} words. Write 25 to 75 words, in 2 to 4 sentences.

minLists.message: This section has no bullet list. Every section except “How Can We Help?” has one short paragraph followed by a bullet list. Add a list of 3 to 8 points, or merge this text into another section.

minItems.message: This article has {n} sections. Use 3 to 5, counting “How Can We Help?”. Add a section.

maxItems.message: This article has {n} sections. Use 3 to 5, counting “How Can We Help?”. Merge short sections, or move question-style ones to the FAQ.

noTrailingColon.message: This heading ends with a colon (“{text}”). Remove the colon.

mustBeEmpty.message: This box should stay empty on articles. Text here replaces the standard call box wording. Clear it.

exactItems.message: This block needs exactly {need} items and has {n}. Add or remove items so there are {need}. These are the 3 action steps the reader should take, not a list of topics.

startsWith.message: Step 1 should be the contact step (“{text}”). Start it with “Describe”, “Discuss” or “Speak With”, for example “Describe The Ceiling Damage”.
Step 2 should be the booking step. Start its heading with “Schedule”, for example “Schedule An Inspection”.
Step 3 should be the result step. Start its heading with “Get”, for example “Get Professional Restoration Service”.

noTrailingColon.message: This heading ends with a colon (“{text}”). Remove the colon.

maxParagraphs.message: This step has {n} paragraphs. Each step is one short paragraph.

maxItems.message: Resources must not use How it works steps: they replace the three action steps on the page. Delete all of the items in this block.

minItems.message: This article has {n} FAQs. Use 4 to 8. Add a question.

maxItems.message: This article has {n} FAQs. Use 4 to 8. Remove one, or merge them.

endsWith.message: This FAQ question should end with a question mark.

maxParagraphs.message: This answer is {n} paragraphs. Keep FAQ answers to one short paragraph.

minWords.message: This answer is {n} words. Keep FAQ answers to one short paragraph of 10 to 60 words. Add a sentence.

maxWords.message: This answer is {n} words. Keep FAQ answers to one short paragraph of 10 to 60 words. Trim it, or move the detail into a section.

sameAs.message: The meta title is different from the Title. Make it the same as the Title, and do not add “Acme Home” at the end: the site adds it.

maxChars.message: The meta title is {n} characters. Keep it to 60 characters or fewer.

minChars.message: The meta description is {n} characters. Aim for 110 to 160 so Google shows it in full.

maxChars.message: The meta description is {n} characters. Aim for 110 to 160 so Google shows it in full.

notEmpty.message: The focus keyword is empty. Set a focus keyword and use the same words in the Title.

containedIn.message: The focus keyword “{text}” does not appear in the Title. Use the same words in both.

exactItems.message: This article has {n} related posts. Pick exactly 3 other articles, and do not pick this article itself.

minItems.message: This article has {n} tags. Pick 2 to 4.

maxItems.message: This article has {n} tags. Pick 2 to 4.

notEmpty.message: No category is chosen. Pick the service this article belongs to, so the page shows the right phone number and links to the right service page.
